associations.rationale: The type states that the vertex generators sum to 1, but it does not itself state pairwise orthogonality or idempotence, so it covers only one component of the complete claim.
The type states pairwise orthogonality for distinct vertex generators, but it does not itself state their sum or idempotence, so it covers only one component of the complete claim.
The type states idempotence of each vertex generator, but it does not itself state their sum or pairwise orthogonality, so it covers only one component of the complete claim.
